## Summary

Describe the user-facing problem and the solution.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when behavior changes.
- [ ] No credentials, generated state, backups, or private data are included.
- [ ] Railway `PORT`, `/healthz`, `/data`, and the loopback-only Gateway remain correct.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has test coverage.
- [ ] A fresh Railway deployment was tested, if deployment behavior changed.
- [ ] An existing-volume upgrade was tested, if OpenClaw or persistent state changed.

## Evidence

Add sanitized logs or screenshots only when they help reviewers. Never include secrets or private domains.
